Academic

Mathematics

I have consistently performed at a high level in competitive mathematics, earning distinctions and awards across multiple national-level contests. I received a silver medal in the OCDSB Grade 9 mathematics competition, achieved a perfect score in the Gauss Math Contest, and earned distinctions in both the Pascal Contest and the Canadian Intermediate Mathematics Contest. These experiences have strengthened my problem-solving speed, logical reasoning, and ability to perform under timed pressure in competitive environments.

Research

Science Fair

As part of my science fair project, I conducted a cost-effectiveness analysis comparing Talazoparib + Enzalutamide versus Enzalutamide + Placebo for mCRPC patients from a Canadian healthcare perspective. The study evaluated outcomes in life years (LYs), quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and total cost to assess both clinical effectiveness and economic value. This project strengthened my research skills, data analysis abilities, and understanding of how mathematical modelling can be applied to real-world healthcare decision-making.

Leadership

Air Cadets

As a Sergeant in an Air Cadets squadron of over 300 cadets, I hold leadership responsibilities including mentoring junior cadets, supporting squadron activities, and maintaining discipline within the unit. I also represented my squadron in the Effective Speaking competition, where I advanced from Squadron level to Regional level, delivering structured speeches under pressure in front of judges and large audiences. This experience strengthened my leadership, communication, and confidence in high-stakes speaking environments while representing a large organization.

Game Development

Pixel Forge Game Jam

As part of the Pixel Forge Game Jam, I contributed to a game project that placed 2nd globally among 80+ entries. The project involved designing and implementing core gameplay mechanics, focusing on interactive systems, user engagement, and balanced game progression. Working under strict time constraints, I helped develop functional game logic and refine the player experience, contributing to the overall success and polish of the final submission.

Hackathon

EOM Hackathon

I placed in the top 5 at the EOM Hackathon, competing against a large pool of participants in a fast-paced development environment. The challenge required rapidly designing, building, and presenting a technical solution within a limited timeframe. This experience strengthened my ability to think under pressure, collaborate effectively, and deliver a functional product in a competitive setting.

Youth Initiative

Vision for Change

Problem

Eye health is often overlooked despite being essential to quality of life. Many individuals lack access to reliable information about vision care, and underserved communities face additional barriers such as limited resources, awareness, and accessibility to proper treatment.

Solution

Vision for Change is a youth-led initiative that addresses these gaps by combining technology with education. The platform focuses on delivering accessible, easy-to-understand information about eye health while exploring ways to expand outreach through digital tools and awareness campaigns.

Impact

By increasing awareness and promoting accessible education, the initiative helps individuals make informed decisions about their vision health. It represents a step toward reducing inequality in access to care while demonstrating how technology can be used as a tool for social impact.

Visit Project
Digital Platform

Inspection 872

Problem

Cadet inspections traditionally rely on manual, paper-based processes that are time-consuming, prone to errors, and lack the ability to track performance dynamically. This limits efficiency and prevents real-time insights into progress.

Solution

Inspection 872 is a digital platform designed to fully modernize the inspection process. It replaces manual workflows with an interactive system that records data in real time, generates performance visualizations, and allows for immediate feedback and analysis.

Impact

The system significantly improves efficiency, accuracy, and transparency within inspections. By transforming a static process into a dynamic, data-driven system, it enables better decision-making and demonstrates the value of integrating technology into structured organizations.

Game Development

Campfire Ottawa Game

Problem

Creating an engaging experience for events can be challenging, as many games either lack simplicity or fail to maintain user interest over time. A balance between accessibility and engagement is often missing.

Solution

The Campfire Ottawa game is a platformer developed for Beneath the Surface, where players aim to reach the top through progressive movement and gameplay challenges. The design emphasizes intuitive mechanics, smooth progression, and an experience that is easy to pick up while still engaging.

Impact

The game provides an interactive and enjoyable experience that encourages persistence and friendly competition. It demonstrates my ability to design systems that are both simple and effective, combining technical development with user-focused design principles.

Game Development — Pixel Forge Game Jam

System Breach

Problem

Most games are built around fixed rules and predictable systems, limiting how players can interact with the environment. While this creates structure, it often restricts creativity and prevents players from experimenting beyond intended gameplay boundaries.

Solution

For the Pixel Forge Game Jam, we built a game inspired by The Matrix where the core mechanic is a built-in "hacked client." Instead of following standard gameplay rules, players are given access to in-game hacks that allow them to actively break and manipulate the system. These mechanics are intentionally designed to let players move beyond normal constraints and interact with the game in unconventional ways.

Impact

The game reinterprets the theme "rules are meant to be broken" by turning rule-breaking into the core gameplay experience. It encourages experimentation, curiosity, and exploration of unintended mechanics within a controlled system. The project demonstrates creative game design, teamwork, and the ability to build engaging systems that challenge traditional gameplay structures.
